title: Xtrata Manifest Envelope
description: Lightweight envelope shared by all Xtrata manifest levels (L0 profile, L1 creator-collection, L2 gallery). Full collection manifests (L3) use xtrata-collection-manifest.schema.json and may additionally carry this envelope for resolver discovery. Manifests are immutable inscriptions; updates are published by inscribing a new manifest whose `supersedes` points at the previous one. Resolvers pick the newest valid manifest inscribed by the address that currently owns `bnsName`.

name.description: URL handle for this manifest, scoped to the owner's BNS name (e.g. /g/dyle.btc/selected-works).

owner.description: Stacks address that inscribed this manifest.

bnsName.description: BNS name this manifest is published under (must be owned by `owner` at read time).

supersedes.description: Inscription id of the manifest this one replaces, forming an update chain.

galleries.description: Profile (L0) manifests only: the owner's published galleries.
